capabilities: Fetch HackerOne reports and earnings via the API
Create and update report notes with frontmatter properties
Generate current-year and all-time earnings summaries
Sync automatically at startup and on a configurable interval
Move the imported folder while updating links and keeping annotations
extras: Warns that the API token is stored unencrypted in .obsidian/plugins/hackerone/data.json and should be excluded from Git, shared backups and other sync services; imported notes live in a reports folder whose Markdown bodies are never overwritten after creation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import HackerOne bug bounty reports and bounty earnings as notes or to track them over time.

relations.evidence: Requires Obsidian 1.6.6 or newer and the Dataview plugin to render the summaries.

summary: HackerOne report importer that pulls your bug bounty reports and earnings into notes with periodic sync and Dataview earnings summaries.
